project: 潮汐微光 / Shallow Sea Dream — ship-ready polished game
goal: Complete, launchable, polished story-first eco-fable game. Fix all known visual/UX bugs, verify full playthrough, ship-quality polish.

stories.title: Level background is clean & bright (no dot/halftone artifact)
acceptanceCriteria: In a running game screenshot of game_scene1, there is NO halftone/dot/checkerboard artifact anywhere in the play field
The level scene is clearly bright and readable (not 'can't see anything') — background, player, entities all legible
dotnet build => 0 errors, 0 warnings; godot --headless --import then --quit => no ERROR/SCRIPT ERROR

stories.title: All in-world sprites render correctly
acceptanceCriteria: Player jellyfish is clearly visible, transparent-background, sensible size (~64-96px), animated
Shards, NPCs, boss, gasoline barrel render as their real art (transparent, correct scale), no leftover procedural placeholder blobs where real art exists
Verified by in-game screenshot showing recognizable sprites

stories.title: Full Level 1 playthrough works end-to-end
acceptanceCriteria: Title -> Tutorial(3 pages) -> transform -> Level 1 loads with no errors
Player can move; collecting water shards advances the 5-shard counter and shows memory vignettes
Talking to NPCs advances objectives; boss purification triggers; settlement panel reachable
No crashes / no SCRIPT ERROR during a play session (verified via game Output panel)

stories.title: All UI screens cohesive, polished, readable
acceptanceCriteria: Title, Tutorial, Dialogue box, HUD (task/minimap/codex/HP/skill), Memory Log, Settlement, Failure all use the unified deep-sea glass theme and rounded font
All text is high-contrast and legible against its panel; no clipped/overflowing labels
Verified by screenshots of each screen

stories.title: Audio: ambient + key SFX present (or clean graceful silence)
acceptanceCriteria: AudioManager loads without errors whether or not OGG files exist
If audio assets are added, they play (ambient loop + shard pickup + purify); if absent, game runs silently with no errors
No missing-resource errors in Output

stories.title: Ship-readiness: clean project, no diagnostics, runnable build
acceptanceCriteria: lsp/dotnet diagnostics: 0 errors across scripts/
No leftover debug-only artifacts, dead code, or _raw backup folders shipped in the play path
project.godot has app name, icon, main scene set; game launches to title cleanly
STRUCTURE.md updated to reflect final state
